name: Simmer
author: E. T. Carter
description: Standing in the lane of a straight desert highway at night: lamp posts lay peach light on the grainy asphalt and lime road paint, timber telephone poles carry sagging wires off to a glowing town on the horizon, and necked hoodoos and a tiered butte stand against a pink and peach sky. Heat rising off the far road makes the distant lamps, poles, headlights and tail lights waver, puts a pale mirage sheen on the far tarmac, and cars slowly come and go.

params.label: Heat shimmer
params.effect: How strongly rising heat bends and wobbles the far road, lights and ridges.

params.label: Mirage
params.effect: How much the hot far road mirrors the sky, ridges and lights upside down.

params.label: Traffic speed
params.effect: How fast the headlights and tail lights travel along the road.

params.label: Lamps
params.effect: Brightness of the roadside lamps, their light cones and the pools they lay on the road.
